pages.text: An hourglass that measures days. Click it to set one to seven; each click turns it over and starts again.

The shard sand in the top bulb runs down over the days you set, so it reads at a glance like a clock face. When the last grain falls it gives one $(thing)redstone pulse$() and turns itself over.$(br2)A $(item)comparator$() reads how much sand is left on top. Sneak-click to ask how long is left.$(br2)In the Nether and the End it cannot find the time: the sand jumps about and never settles.
